title: Valos connector manifest
description: Public manifest for a Valos connector package. It names the connector, its entry module, and the operations it may perform. It does not carry credentials or network endpoints.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Only version 1 is accepted.

name.description: Connector id: lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens.

description.description: Short human-readable summary of the connector.

entry.description: Relative path to the connector entry module (.js or .mjs). Absolute paths and parent segments are rejected.

capabilities.description: Allowlisted operations this connector can perform.
